rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for pretending to be another person, especially without stressing fraud.

example.english: They always impersonate the teacher, making the whole class laugh.
example.traditional: 佢成日扮老師，搞到全班笑晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 lou5 si1 gaau2 dou3 cyun4 baan1 siu3 saai3

rows.note: Use this when someone falsely claims to be another person, especially for deception or illegal gain.

example.english: Someone tried to impersonate a bank employee to scam me, but luckily I did not fall for it.
example.traditional: 有人冒充銀行職員打電話呃我，幸好我冇上當。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 mou6 cung1 ngan4 hong4 zik1 jyun4 daa2 din6 waa2 ngaak1 ngo5 hang6 hou2 ngo5 mou5 soeng5 dong3
